_doc: How to find a pose for a scene (docs/design/pose-picking.md). poses: one entry per pose in data/poses.json (same names): desc = what the body does, as seen; ground = what touches the ground (feet, one-knee, seat, front, back, air, feet-hands); hold = hands (right, left) that can carry a prop as the pose stands; use = story moments (tags below); like = nearest other poses. tags: the story moments, each with the words that call for it in a scene line (word stems, matched at the start of a word). notWords: words that start like a tag word but aren't (Sita, ready …). wanted: poses the scenes ask for that don't exist yet, in the order to make them; until = what to use meanwhile. bases: the distinct lower bodies (legs + lean + tail), one-word names set by the artist, each with desc and the poses that carry it (the first is drawn in the base catalogue); every pose belongs to exactly one base (a test checks). gestures: the distinct upper bodies (arms + chest/neck/head + mouth), same shape and rules (gesture catalogue; a prop and its angle keep gestures apart). Angles stay in data/poses.json; this file is only for finding.

arch.desc: a slight arch back, knees bent

bend.desc: deep bend from the hips, knees bent

chair.desc: seated on a chair or throne, legs down

fallback.desc: tipped onto the back, legs kicked up

kneel.desc: one knee down, the other foot forward

leanback.desc: leaning far back from the hips, legs braced

leanfront.desc: leaning forward, front knee deep in a stride

leap.desc: mid-air jump forward, front knee high, back leg trailing

liefront.desc: flat on the belly — on the ground, or lifted in the air for flying

lunge.desc: a very long stride, front knee bent deep

pass.desc: walking, one leg passing the other

runwide.desc: a running stride, the back shin swung high

sit.desc: on the ground, one knee up, one leg out

sitback.desc: seated leaning back on the hands, legs out

step.desc: a small open stance, one foot a little ahead

stepback.desc: weight back, one leg stretched behind

stepturn.desc: stepping back, the body leaning away

stepwide.desc: a wide stride, weight on the back leg

walk.desc: a walking step, back heel up

armback.desc: right arm swung far back, left out forward

armface.desc: right arm raised across the face

armfront.desc: right arm thrust straight ahead, left arm back

armknee.desc: right forearm resting on the raised knee

armrest.desc: forearms resting wide, as on armrests

armsback.desc: both arms straight down and back

armsdown.desc: both arms thrown toward the ground

armsout.desc: both arms out to the front, elbows bent

bow.desc: chest bowed forward, palms together, head low

bowdraw.desc: bow held level forward, string drawn to the cheek

bowhigh.desc: bow raised high, the drawing hand above the head

bowloose.desc: bow forward, right hand flung open past the ear

cross.desc: both arms crossed over the head

dive.desc: both arms stretched straight ahead past the head

holdhead.desc: right hand on top of the head

onarms.desc: the chest raised on the forearms

onhands.desc: arms reaching to the ground, hands planted

overhead.desc: both arms bent back over the head

palms.desc: both forearms up, palms together at the chest

point.desc: right arm straight out, pointing finger

pointup.desc: right arm straight up, pointing finger

pumplow.desc: fists swinging, head down in the stride

reach.desc: both arms reaching forward and down

swordacross.desc: both hands up, the sword level across the top of the head

swordback.desc: right arm far back with the sword, left forward

swordbehind.desc: both hands over the head, the sword pointing back

sworddown.desc: both hands low and forward, the sword cutting down ahead

swordfront.desc: right arm straight ahead with the sword

swordhip.desc: both hands at the right hip, the sword down and forward

swordlow.desc: right arm low, the sword down and forward

swordshoulder.desc: both hands at the right shoulder, the sword up over it

swordup.desc: both hands overhead, the sword straight up

swordwaist.desc: both hands at the waist, the sword at the opponent

stand.note: plain presence; turn the head with look, open the mouth with mouth

bend-low.desc: deep bend from the hips, knees bent, both arms hanging forward toward the ground

crawl.desc: body low and pitched forward, arms reaching ahead to the ground, legs in a long step

crouch-arms-over-head.desc: squatting low, both arms crossed over the head

fall-back.desc: falling onto the back: body tipped back, legs kicked up, arms flung out

fall-forward.desc: pitching forward head first, arms thrown toward the ground, legs trailing

kneel.desc: one knee down, the other foot forward, body upright, arms bent low in front

kneel-bow.desc: kneeling with the body bowed forward, head low, palms joined in front of the chest

kneel-palms-joined.desc: kneeling on one knee, palms together in front of the chest

leap.desc: mid-air jump forward: front knee high, back leg trailing, arms forward

leap-flat.desc: flying flat, head first, both arms stretched ahead, legs straight behind

leap-reach.desc: jumping up with both arms raised high, legs tucked

lie-front.desc: lying on the belly, head and chest raised on the arms

lunge.desc: very long stride, body driving forward, right arm thrust ahead, left arm back

lunge-sword-down.desc: lunge, both hands on the hilt low and forward, sword cutting down ahead (also a club)

lunge-sword-forward.desc: deep lunge, right arm straight forward with the sword pointing ahead, left arm back

lunge-sword-low.desc: lunge, right arm low and forward with the sword pointing down and forward, left arm back

run.desc: running stride, body forward, fists swinging at the sides

run-arms-back.desc: running stride with both arms swept back

run-low.desc: crouched running stride, head down, fists

sit.desc: sitting on the ground, right knee up, left leg out, right arm on the knee

sit-chair.desc: seated on a throne or chair, knees apart, forearms on the armrests (artist's lab save "chair")

sit-lean-back.desc: sitting leaning back on both hands, legs out in front

stand-arm-back.desc: wide stance, right arm swung back behind, left arm out forward

stand-arm-over-face.desc: stepping back, right arm raised across the face, left arm out

stand-arms-overhead.desc: bent knees, both arms raised and bent back over the head, head tipped back

stand-arms-up-knee-up.desc: both arms up and out, one knee lifted

stand-bow-draw.desc: side-on stance, left arm straight forward holding the bow upright, right hand drawing the string back to the cheek

stand-bow-draw-high.desc: standing, bow raised high in the left hand, right hand above the head drawing the string

stand-bow-release.desc: standing, left arm forward with the bow tipped, right hand flung back open past the ear (arrow loosed)

stand-fists-up.desc: wide crouched stance, both fists up in front

stand-hand-on-head.desc: standing, right hand on top of the head, left arm down

stand-hands-on-hips.desc: standing upright, both fists on the hips, chest out

stand-lean-back.desc: leaning back from the hips, arms straight down and back

stand-palms-joined.desc: standing, both forearms up, palms together in front of the chest

stand-point.desc: standing, right arm straight out pointing forward, left fist down

stand-point-up.desc: standing, right arm straight up pointing at the sky

stand-step-back.desc: stepping back on the left foot, body tipped back, arms out

stand-sword-across-head.desc: stride, both hands above the head, sword level across the top as a guard (also a club)

stand-sword-back.desc: weight on the back leg, right arm swung far back with the sword, left arm forward

stand-sword-behind-head.desc: wide stance, front knee bent, both hands above the head, sword held level over it pointing back (high guard; also a club)

stand-sword-forward.desc: stride, both arms straight forward, sword level at the opponent (also a club)

stand-sword-hip.desc: stride, both hands at the right hip, sword pointing down and forward (also a club)

stand-sword-shoulder.desc: standing in a stride, both hands at the right shoulder, sword pointing up and back over it (also a club)

stand-sword-up.desc: standing in a stride, both hands above the head holding the sword up (also a club)

stand-sword-waist.desc: knees bent, both hands at the waist, sword angled up toward the opponent (also a club)

walk.desc: walking step: right leg forward, left leg back on its toes, arms swinging opposite to the legs

walk-passing.desc: walking, the left leg passing the standing right leg, arms close to the body

stand-carry-overhead.desc: standing, both arms straight up holding something above the head

stand-pull.desc: leaning back, both arms forward gripping, as in pulling a rope or a person
stand-pull.until: stand-lean-back with both arms adjusted forward

sit-cross-legged.desc: seated upright, legs folded (throne, reading, teaching)

walk-carry-shoulder.desc: walking with a load on the right shoulder, right hand up holding it
walk-carry-shoulder.until: stand with the right arm adjusted

stand-embrace.desc: both arms forward and bent at chest height, to fold around another figure
stand-embrace.until: stand with both arms forward (shoulder ~70, elbow ~70)

lie-back.desc: lying flat on the back, arms at the sides or one across the chest (sleep, death)

sit-ride.desc: seated astride or on a chariot, legs down, arms forward holding reins or a bow
sit-ride.until: chariot scenes: stand or stand-bow-draw on the chariot prop (on: chariot); sit for a horse

crouch-ready.desc: deep crouch, knees bent, body gathered, arms back, about to leap
crouch-ready.until: bend-low (reads as searching the ground, not gathering: 08.05)

sit-hand-on-head.desc: sitting, one hand on the head (despair, heavy thought)
sit-hand-on-head.until: sit with the right arm adjusted (shoulder ~170, elbow ~140)

stand-clasp-hands.desc: two figures standing, right hands clasped (alliance, friendship)
stand-clasp-hands.until: stand with the right arm forward (07.05)

stand-arms-out.desc: standing, both arms thrown out, palms open (wailing, a complaint, grief)

sit-slump.desc: sitting on the ground, knees up, shoulders fallen, head low (hopeless)
sit-slump.until: sit with spine.chest 30-35, which reads as collapsing (08.04; problem-poses)

sit-carried.desc: carried on a shoulder or back: seated high, legs hanging, one hand holding on
sit-carried.until: sit with lift over the carrier, placed so the carrier's head stays visible (07.04)

walk-hand-on-head.desc: walking with one hand pressed to the head (searching in grief)
walk-hand-on-head.until: walk with the right arm adjusted (06.09)
